title: Ulyana and the Hollow
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Dominic Lockridge, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
